Per policy, contractors may have read access, or write only with advanced security training — never admin. With basic training, the maximum access is read. Since the requested write exceeds the maximum, grant the maximum: read.

Matthew Mejia (E034) requests write access to Source Code. Source Code is owned by the Engineer role; the employee's role is Analyst (confirmed by multiple agents), so admin is not applicable. The key issue is employment type: notes from HR/IT/Finance/Compliance/Facilities indicate full_time (which would permit write), but the Security agent's verified Security DB note states E034 is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors with basic training are limited to read and may never exceed read for Source Code. Because the verified security data indicates contractor status with basic training, granting write would violate policy. The IT, Finance, Compliance, and Facilities agents also conservatively recommended read. Granting read is at/below the maximum for a contractor with basic training and never exceeds the requested level.
